name: Targeted Incremental Baseline Refactoring
description: When applying follow-up creative changes (copywriting, typography scales, colorways, sections, or interactive features), preserve the delivered architectural structure, styling system, and motion tokens as the baseline. Prefer small, targeted, non-destructive delta edits over regenerating the entire site.
designPhilosophy: When applying follow-up creative changes (copywriting, typography scales, colorways, sections, or interactive features), preserve the delivered architectural structure, styling system, and motion tokens as the baseline
implementationApproach: Preserve working component boundaries, avoid layout thrashing, and maintain local dev server review synchronization after each meaningful iteration.
performanceConsiderations: Utilize translate3d, will-change sparingly, and clamp animation timelines under 600ms.
accessibilityRequirements: Provide prefers-reduced-motion override and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard focus visibility.
